risks.description: Estimated cost uses 97.6% of the INR 350,000 budget and past projects averaged a 25.2% cost overrun (e.g., Winter Clearance ran 26% over).
mitigation: Introduce a strict cost‑tracking dashboard with daily updates
Negotiate contingency release only after key milestones are met

risks.description: Task 3.3 (Produce final ad creatives) is on the critical path with 0 slack, so any delay pushes the 2026-11-25 deadline.
mitigation: Start design work for 3.3 immediately after 2.3 finishes
Allocate an extra Designer for overlapping days if budget permits

risks.description: Task 4.1 (Track ad performance and adjust bids) is critical with 0 slack; delays affect campaign optimisation before the 2026-11-25 deadline.
mitigation: Begin performance tracking as soon as 3.5 is done
Add a backup Media Buyer for peak monitoring periods

risks.description: Designer is over‑allocated (up to 3 concurrent tasks but only 2 designers), risking delays on tasks 2.3, 3.3 and 3.7.
mitigation: Reschedule non‑critical design tasks to free capacity
Hire a freelance Designer for peak weeks

risks.description: Media Buyer is over‑allocated (up to 2 concurrent tasks but only 1 buyer), affecting tasks 3.5 and 4.1.
mitigation: Split ad‑setup (3.5) into smaller batches handled sequentially
Secure a part‑time Media Buyer for the monitoring phase

risks.description: Influencer fees are fixed up front; if task 3.6 (Negotiate and contract influencers) slips, the partnership pack (5.2) may miss deliverable scope.
mitigation: Start influencer negotiations in parallel with design work
Create backup influencer list to switch quickly if contracts delay

risks.description: Critical task 3.3 must be completed quickly, increasing risk of sub‑par ad creatives that could lower campaign performance.
mitigation: Implement a rapid review checklist before final approval
Allocate a senior Designer to audit creative quality
